definitions.explanation: a floor of a building that is below ground level

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地階|ちかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The food section is on the basement floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{地階|ちかい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the elevator down to the basement floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地階|ちかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{洋菓子|ようがし}→洋菓子：04998_yougashi⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何軒|なんけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The basement floor of this department store has several well-known Western confectionery shops.

notes:
Composed of {地|ち} (ground/earth) and ⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧ (floor/story). Refers to any underground floor of a building. In Japanese department stores, the {地階|ちかい} (often abbreviated as B1) is typically where the food hall (⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧ or ⟦デパ{地下|ちか}→デパ地下：08828_depachika⟧) is located.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地階|ちかい}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: basement sales floor
- {地階|ちかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: basement parking
- {地階|ちかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to go down to the basement
- {地階|ちかい}⟦{一階|いっかい}→一階：27512_ikkai⟧: basement level 1 (B1)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧: underground, basement — more general term, also used as a prefix (e.g., ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧)
- ⟦{地下室|ちかしつ}→地下室：12047_chikashitsu⟧: basement room — a specific room underground, not a building floor
- {階下|かいか}: downstairs — relative term meaning the floor below, not necessarily underground
